regime_context: The detector shows a narrow (4/17 eligible), non-rotational leadership structure with Energy (H-shares) clearly ahead of Banks (H + HK) on momentum-rank, durability, breadth, and trend-health; the absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so it is worth honoring for de-risking even though momentum rank itself is not alpha. All but two themes are unscorable, and the most scorable ones (China Tech & Internet, China Platform Megacaps) rank at the bottom, so most testable subjects here must lean on unscorable/unlisted proxies and carry low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) leadership starts to fade via a confirmed fall in its durability_bar from 0.76 toward 0.5 or below — that observable would retire the 'staying-power leader' read and suggest the narrow leadership is rolling over.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the clear prevailing narrative: rank 1, eligible, strongest durability (0.76), Hurst tag 'trend', broadest participation (breadth 0.8), and not crowded. The validated leg here is the absolute-trend gate — staying in an eligible, trending leader supports drawdown control even if momentum rank has no return-forecast edge. This is a staying-power overweight, not a momentum-return bet.
theses.dissent: Energy is an unscorable H-share theme with no ETF proxy; the breadth and trend metrics are coincident, and in a gate-helps-true regime the real edge is only in avoiding shakeouts, meaning a sudden broad risk-off would hit this leader as hard as any theme despite the healthy mechanical tone.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) leadership unwinds such that its durable-trend reading drops below eligibility (durability_bar falls meaningfully from 0.76) before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks ranks second and eligible, but its Hurst tag is 'mean-revert' and it is the only crowded theme in the universe (crowding_z 1.09). Crowding is a size-down caution only, not a fade, so this is expressed as avoiding new exposure rather than shorting — the challenger shows weaker staying-power texture than the leader and mean-reversion character argues against chasing it.
theses.dissent: Banks is the only challenger within striking distance (margin 0.136) and could absorb leadership if Energy wobbles; crowding flags in mean-reversion names sometimes mark continued inflows rather than tops, so an outright negative lean on a second-ranked eligible theme risks being early against flow.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) narrows the leadership margin to Energy decisively (score approaches or overtakes 1.518) before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips sits third and eligible with middling-trend durability (0.73, 'mixed'), uncrowded but lacking the trend-health of the leader. Given the gate's only validated edge is drawdown avoidance and this theme is not broken out as a durable leader or absorber, there is no positive case to add here against the dominant Energy narrative.
theses.dissent: In a narrow-rotation, one-narrative-false regime, income-oriented diversification in an uncrowded eligible theme is exactly the kind of low-beta ballast a trend-gate allocator might hold through a shakeout — avoiding it forgoes genuine diversification value even without return edge.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips overtakes Banks (H + HK) into a clear second-ranked eligible slot before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
